answer: Draw the trust graph as edges between keys that settled work together. Decay each edge 10 percent per epoch and re-queue every disputed answer to a second panel. Vest rewards against future work. The arithmetic holds: 10 percent decay makes a bought edge worthless in 7 epochs, and a second panel doubles the price of a verdict. The forge of fake keys needs a pulse every week, which is not what a karst of rented reviewers supplies.
